phase2_9_completed_steps.note: Replaces sim/wind.py's _gust_realization/_gust (half-normal random weights, no altitude dependence, never the spectrum architecture.md SS16 had promised since Step 21) with the real MIL-F-8785C/MIL-HDBK-1797 Dryden model: altitude-dependent scale length/intensity (AGL, via the existing gravity.altitude_agl), amplitudes from the published PSD renormalized to an exact variance identity (also fixing a real Step-21 bug -- its own normalization was off by sqrt(2)), and two horizontal components (u along-wind, v cross-wind) composed as a vector perturbation of the mean wind instead of one scalar on its speed, which also removes the old non-negativity clamp (a negative along-component is now correctly a reversed local flow, not a bug). Four design forks resolved by the user before speccing: Dryden not von Karman, altitude-dependent not flat, a fixed reference airspeed (documented limitation, bounded -- after renormalization V affects only the spectrum's break frequency, never the delivered intensity), and a user-set high-altitude intensity field rather than a MIL chart lookup.
